data.name: Essa
data.gender_notes: Essa is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Essa is the Arabic name for Jesus Christ, considered a prophet in Islam. It signifies the Messiah and is mentioned in the Quran. The name Essa carries the meaning “The Messiah, Jesus Christ” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Essa usually hope their child will grow to embody the messiah, jesus christ and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In the Quran, Essa (Jesus) is a spirit from Allah, sent as a messenger and a sign for the people.
data.etymology: Essa belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “The Messiah, Jesus Christ.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Essa total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: عيسى
in_arabic.long_meaning: عيسى هو الاسم الذى يُطلق على المسيح في الإسلام، ويعني المولود بعد الوعد، أو المبعوث، وهو واحد من أهم الشخصيات في الإسلام، ويعتبره المسلمون نبيًا ورسولًا، وقد وردت آيات كثيرة في القرآن الكريم عن حياته وممارساته الدينية، ويعتبره المسلمون ملهمًا للناس ورسولًا للحق.

in_urdu.name: عیسا
in_urdu.meaning: مسیح، وعد کے بعد پیدا ہوا، مبعوث
in_urdu.long_meaning: عیسا کے نام سے مسیح کو مسلمان انہیں کہتے ہیں، جو کہ وعد کے بعد پیدا ہوا ہے، یا مبعوث، اسلام میں یہایک اہم شخصیت ہے، اور مسلمانوں کے نزدیک وہ نبی اور رسول ہیں، قرآن کریم میں ان کی زندگی اور دینی مظاہر سے کئی آیات منسوخیں ہیں، اور مسلمانوں کے نزدیک وہ ہیں مہدی اور انہیں حق کی طرف مبعوث کیا گیا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: ईसा
in_hindi.meaning: मसीह, वाद के बाद पैदा हुआ, भेजा गया
in_hindi.long_meaning: ईसा मसीह को ही मुसलमान ईसा कहकर संबोधते हैं, जो कि वाद के बाद पैदा हुआ है या भेजा गया है, इस्लाम में ये एक महत्वपूर्ण व्यक्तित्व है, और मुसलमानों के अनुसार ये नबी और रसूल है, कुरान में उनके जीवन और धार्मिक कार्यों से कई आयातें हैं, और मुसलमानों के अनुसार ये ही हैं महदी और उन्हें सच्चाई की ओर भेजा गया है।

in_pashto.name: عيسى
in_pashto.meaning: مسيح، وعد کې پيدايښت، د پانګولویښتنه
in_pashto.long_meaning: عيسا د مسيح تر ټاکي، چې د وعد کې پيدايښت کړى، يا د پانګولویښتنه، د اسلام په اسلام کې دا يو مهم شخصيت دی، او په مسلمانو کې دی هغه نبی او رسول دی، کوراني آیاتو کې د هغه د ژوند او ديني چارو له منځه تلو آیات کې دي، او په مسلمانو کې دی د هغه د ژوند له امله هغه په مېلاني پانګولويښتنه کړى دی، يا د هغه په مېلاني پانګولويښتنه کړى دی.

in_english.name: Essa
in_english.meaning: The Messiah, the promised one, the sent one, a prophet and messenger
in_english.long_meaning: Essa is the name given to the Messiah in Islam, meaning the one who is born after the promise, or the sent one. He is one of the most important figures in Islam, and Muslims believe him to be a prophet and a messenger. There are many verses in the Quran that describe his life and religious practices, and Muslims consider him to be a guide and a messenger of truth.

Muslims believe that Jesus, who is also called Isa in Arabic, was born miraculously, which is mentioned in the Quran. Prophet Jesus, or Isa, is recognized for his actions during the latter part of Prophet Muhammad's life. The beautiful name 'Essa carries an immense sense of respect and reverence in Islamic cultures, and it serves as a reminder of the shared beliefs and connections between Jews, Christians, and Muslims.
data.spiritual_significance: In spiritual terms, Essa, or Jesus, represents the purest human form of servitude and devotion to God in the Islamic faith. He is considered a potential savior, the Messiah, and a prophet sent by Allah. Essa's story is an essential component of the broader narrative of divine revelation in both Christianity and Islam. Adopting the name Essa, therefore, is believed to bring blessings and protect the bearer from harm. Additionally, the name Essa symbolizes the love, compassion, mercy, and belief in divine guidance central to Islamic teachings.
